summary.oneLiner: Volume-led structural growth story: scaling from ~0.5 mn t/yr toward a 2 mn t capacity vision (1.4 mn t by FY27 exit, ~1.7 mn t FY28), while shifting mix toward value-added/coated products (39% → targeted ~50% by FY27) to defend/expand EBITDA/ton — but Q4 reported numbers are heavily distorted by ~INR700 cr of low-margin opportunistic steel trading (stock-in-trade), so **volume and EBITDA/ton are the only clean read-throughs.**

thesis (1-liner): Volume-led structural growth story: scaling from ~0.5 mn t/yr toward a 2 mn t capacity vision (1.4 mn t by FY27 exit, ~1.7 mn t FY28), while shifting mix toward value-added/coated products (39% → targeted ~50% by FY27) to defend/expand EBITDA/ton — but Q4 reported numbers are heavily distorted by ~INR700 cr of low-margin opportunistic steel trading (stock-in-trade), so **volume and EBITDA/ton are the only clean read-throughs.**
scorecard (with yoy + notes):
| Metric | Q4 FY26 | Q4 FY25 | YoY | Note |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Volume (MT)** | 1.47 lakh t | 1.16 lakh t | **+27%** | The clean growth signal mgmt told analysts to focus on |
| Revenue | INR1,480 cr | INR734 cr | +102% | ⚠️ INFLATED by trading/stock-in-trade pass-through (~INR700 cr over Q3+Q4); NOT representative of manufacturing growth |
| EBITDA | INR46 cr | INR35 cr | +33% | |
| **EBITDA/ton** | INR3,150 | INR3,000 | +5% | Cleaner profitability read; FY26 full-year ~INR3,260 (stable) |
| Total comprehensive income (~PAT proxy) | INR18 cr | INR17.5 cr | +3% | Held flat despite higher energy + ocean-freight costs |
| Net debt / leverage | D/E 0.18x | 0.15x | up | Current ratio 2.17x; leverage still low/comfortable |

**FY26 (full year):** Volume 5.32 lakh t (vs 4.85, +9.7%) · Revenue INR4,200 cr (+37%) · EBITDA INR174 cr (+8%) · Income INR77 cr (vs 73, +5%) · EBITDA/ton ~INR3,260 (stable) · VAP mix 39%.

> **⭐ STEEL INVENTORY / TRADING CALL-OUT:** Cost of stock-in-trade spiked — ~INR21 cr context cited but trading volume ~INR300 cr in Q3 and ~INR700 cr total across Q3+Q4. Driver: (a) opportunistic import cargo bought during geopolitical/price volatility; (b) year-end supplier commitment lifting to protect discounts/rebates (HRC, CR, GI mix). Margin on this is "very nominal." Mgmt deducts this volume from the 27% growth figure; expects trading to **decline** as 3 newly commissioned plants (Secunderabad, Gujarat, Jammu) ramp utilisation. March was "extreme volatility" — they cleared stock to avoid price-loss.
guidance (critical):
- **Volume FY27:** 6.5–7.0 lakh tons (vs 5.32 in FY26).
- **Volume FY28:** ~8.5 lakh tons (conservative, at ~62–65% util of 1.4 mn t; 70% = peak).
- **EBITDA/ton FY27 & FY28:** INR3,500–4,000 "comfortable" if markets/demand-supply aligned & no volatility (vs ~INR3,260 FY26).
- **Value-added mix:** ~50% by end-FY27 (from 39%), driven by DFT + Hindupur (both VAP-heavy).
- **Capacity:** 1.4 mn t operational by Q4 FY27; ~1.7 mn t by FY28; long-term vision 2 mn t with +1 mn t by FY29.
- **Capex:** ~INR100 cr already in CWIP; ~INR300 cr more to reach 2 mn t; of which INR75–100 cr in FY27, balance over next 2 yrs.
demand / pipeline: Supplies to marquee projects across data centres, railways, solar, infrastructure, power. Long-term demand drivers cited: infra build-out, construction, renewable-energy investment, water-transportation projects, rising industrial demand. Secured international certifications (Europe, America, Middle East) to expand exports.
segment — value-added vs commodity: VAP mix reached **39% of FY26 mix** (target ~50% by FY27). Newly established 300×300 hollow section gaining traction. Hindupur dedicated to coated tubes, pre-galvanized/galvanized tubes (mainly solar). Commodity ERW/hollow sections remain volume base; trading (stock-in-trade) is non-core, nominal margin.
growth / optionality:
- **API / oil & gas pipes** (Sanand): 1.5 yrs of equipment work; full readiness Q3 FY27 (also cited Q4 FY27 facility readiness). Start with water applications → migrate to oil & gas; large export potential boosted by rupee depreciation.
- **Hindupur greenfield** (AP): ~1.5 lakh t coated-tube facility, fully integrated, solar-focused, good expected EBITDA/ton; operational Q4 FY27.
- **DFT facility Sanand U2 Phase-3:** operational Q3 FY27, high-margin pipe segments.
- **Sri City/Chennai:** on track, commissioned this FY, full benefit FY28; +1.5 lakh t.
- **300×300 hollow sections:** newly established, encouraging response.
margins & cost:
- EBITDA/ton ~INR3,150 Q4 / ~INR3,260 FY26; guidance INR3,500–4,000.
- Headwinds: gas-price volatility + intermittent gas availability; elevated ocean freight; higher energy input costs — temporary, industry-wide.
- Mitigation: operational optimisation, prudent inventory management, product diversification, cost-efficiency.
capex: ~INR100 cr in CWIP; ~INR300 cr remaining for 2 mn t; INR75–100 cr in FY27. FY28 capacity adds: Sanand +1.5 lakh t, Hindupur +2 lakh t, Sri City/Chennai +1.5 lakh t, UP plant +2 lakh t.
capital allocation: INR90 cr **preferential issue to promoter group** — funds working capital for the 1 mn t → 2 mn t expansion (not project capex per se). Maintains healthy balance sheet; D/E 0.18x, current ratio 2.17x.
risks:
- Reported revenue/margins distorted by low-margin trading — quality-of-earnings flag; gross profit/ton looks weak vs peers when trading not stripped out.
- Gas price/availability volatility; ocean-freight cost; energy costs.
- Execution risk on multiple simultaneous greenfield/brownfield builds (Hindupur, Sanand, Chennai, UP) all targeted Q4 FY27.
- API segment unproven; approvals/certification timeline still open.
- Promoter preferential issue (dilution / related-party financing).
management tone: Confident, expansion-focused. Transparent on the trading distortion when pressed by analysts (acknowledged it "does not contribute anything" and steered focus to 27% volume growth). Optimistic on exports post-rupee-depreciation.
non-obvious points:
- Bulk of Q4 revenue "growth" is a one-off steel-trading pass-through (~INR700 cr Q3+Q4), nominal margin — headline +102% rev growth is misleading.
- Steel MOUs done via the trading lift help **secure HRC/steel supply for FY27** (strategic, not just opportunistic).
- 16.5 MW captive solar = ~35% of power need; green-hydrogen pilot at Secunderabad U1 — cost & ESG lever.
- 3 plants commissioned in Q4 (Secunderabad, Gujarat, Jammu) → utilisation ramp should reduce trading dependence.
challenges → beneficiaries:
- ⭐ Rupee depreciation → makes Indian pipe/tube exports competitive → HITECH export push (Europe/America/ME) + API oil-&-gas export optionality.
- ✅ Import-substitution in API oil-&-gas line pipe (currently import-heavy) → domestic supplier beneficiaries.
- Solar capex cycle → demand for solar tubes/mounting structures (Hindupur).

Major one-off: ~INR700 cr low-margin steel trading (stock-in-trade) inflated revenue to INR1,480 cr (+102%). Guidance: FY27 vol 6.5–7.0 lakh t, FY28 ~8.5 lakh t; EBITDA/ton INR3,500–4,000; VAP →50% by FY27; capacity 1.4 mn t (FY27) → 1.7 mn t (FY28) → 2 mn t vision. themes.title: Steel tubes & building-materials capex beneficiaries
themes.need: Domestic capex + import-substitution lift value-added steel tubes/pipes and building materials - APLAPOLLO/HITECH/JTLIND/SURYAROSNI/SAMBHV/VENUSPIPES on structural & SS tubes (solar structures, DC cooling, API), FINPIPE/SUPREMEIND/APOLLOPIPE on PVC pipes, MAANALU on aluminium extrusions, RATNAVEER on SS fasteners. A data-center-cooling adjacency adds margin optionality.
themes.driver: Capex commissioning converting to volume; solar-structure & infra demand; commodity pass-through.
